stem: In which table are the check marks placed in all the correct boxes?

options.label: A
options.text:
Circle: none checked for Quadrilateral or Rhombus, checked for Polygon
Triangle: none checked for Quadrilateral or Rhombus, checked for Polygon
Parallelogram: checked for Quadrilateral, none for Rhombus, checked for Polygon

options.label: B
options.text:
Square: checked for Quadrilateral, Rhombus, Polygon
Triangle: none checked for Quadrilateral or Rhombus, checked for Polygon
Rectangle: checked for Quadrilateral, none for Rhombus, checked for Polygon

options.label: C
options.text:
Square: checked for Quadrilateral, none for Rhombus or Polygon
Triangle: none checked for Quadrilateral, Rhombus, or Polygon
Rectangle: checked for Quadrilateral, none for Rhombus or Polygon

options.label: D
options.text:
Circle: none checked for Quadrilateral or Rhombus, none for Polygon
Triangle: none checked for Quadrilateral or Rhombus, checked for Polygon
Parallelogram: none checked for Quadrilateral or Rhombus, checked for Polygon
